topology.cloud: AetherCloud node-mqtt adapter + CloudLink ingress + application use cases

scenarios.expected: both real MQTT transports reconnect and subscriptions recover
scenarios.observed: Mosquitto restarted 1 time; Edge continued through a new connection

scenarios.expected: MQTT PUBACK does not delete the spool; identical business identity is replayed
scenarios.observed: one pending FileCloudLinkSpool record survived, then replay received the stable ACK

scenarios.expected: Cloud returns the durable stream/epoch/position tuple it owns
scenarios.observed: second Edge process received manifest/1/1 while telemetry/1/1 still replayed after its lost ACK

scenarios.expected: a second Edge OS process recovers the retained record
scenarios.observed: phase two reopened the phase-one journal with pending_records=1

scenarios.expected: without a production durable store, continuity is unknown and must not be claimed
scenarios.observed: new Cloud process rolled session epoch back and re-accepted the replay as unknown

scenarios.expected: repeated QoS 1 payload does not create a second business fact
scenarios.observed: same position/batch/digest returned the same logical receipt
application repository reported replay and emitted an unsigned application ACK
application rejected the conflicting replay; Edge timed out waiting for ACK

scenarios.expected: loss is an explicit application fact, never a silent cursor jump
scenarios.observed: record-data-loss command persisted one fact and emitted its application ACK

scenarios.expected: gap is retained but cumulative ACK is withheld
scenarios.observed: repository returned a gap receipt and Edge received no ACK

scenarios.expected: evaluation_time >= expires_at is rejected before application persistence
scenarios.observed: ingress returned message-expired and published no ACK

scenarios.expected: non-durable/buffered application result never creates an ACK
scenarios.observed: durablyAcknowledged=false and Edge received no ACK
